analytical_result: For fixed-energy concentration u_lambda=lambda^(3/2)v(lambda x), b_required scales like lambda^(5/2), while ||omega||_Lp scales like lambda^(5/2-3/p). Therefore every finite-p magnitude-only coefficient C||omega||_Lp is too weak. p=infinity is not rejected by this scaling argument.
interpretation: Endpoint normalization is numerically stronger on the sampled trajectories, but neither sampled grid Linf nor the Fourier l1 envelope supplies the independent time-integral estimate required by L3. The next diagnostic should compare the remaining dimensionless factor b_required/endpoint-scale with geometric depletion variables.
warning: b_required is circular; finite-grid Linf is a sampled lower estimate of the continuum supremum; these data do not prove an endpoint regularity criterion.
